name: tabia-cli
description: Reaching a deployed Tabia environment from the command line with the `tabia` CLI: profiles and personal access tokens, reading through `tabia ls` and `tabia api`, and moving care pathways, flows and surveys between environments or organizations with export/plan/resolve/import. Encodes the guardrails that matter — personal data stays out of the transcript, and nothing is written to production without a human at the prompt.
